def _line(x, y):
    """Resistant pairwise slope start, then refit with bounded influence."""
    i, j = np.triu_indices(len(x), 1)
    dx = x[i] - x[j]
    good = np.abs(dx) > 1e-06
    if not good.any():
        return np.array([1.0, np.median(y - x) if len(x) else 0.0])
    slope = np.median((y[i[good]] - y[j[good]]) / dx[good])
    b = np.array([slope, np.median(y - slope * x)])
    a = np.column_stack((x, np.ones(len(x))))
    for _ in range(8):
        r = y - a @ b
        s = max(0.0001, 1.4826 * np.median(np.abs(r - np.median(r))))
        w = 1.0 / np.hypot(1.0, r / (2.5 * s))
        b = np.linalg.lstsq(a * w[:, None], y * w, rcond=None)[0]
    return b

def _design(tau, x, h, p, memory, dt, t):
    tau = np.asarray(tau)
    after = np.r_[np.cumsum(dt[:0:-1])[::-1], 0.0]
    a = after[:, None] / tau
    b = dt[:, None] / tau
    decay = np.exp(-a)
    jump = -np.expm1(-b)
    carry = memory * np.exp(-dt.sum() / tau)
    gap = h[:, None] - p @ (decay * jump) - carry
    dgap = -(p @ (decay * (a * jump - b * np.exp(-b)) / tau))
    dgap -= carry * dt.sum() / tau ** 2
    q = t[:, None] / tau
    shape = -np.expm1(-q)
    dshape = -np.exp(-q) * q / tau
    curves = np.concatenate((gap[:, None, :] * shape, x[:, None, :] * t[None, :, None]), axis=2)
    rates = np.column_stack((gap / tau, x))
    dc = dgap[:, None, :] * shape + gap[:, None, :] * dshape
    dr = (dgap - gap / tau) / tau
    return (curves, rates, dc, dr)

def _wing_blend(x, h, p, dt, t, threshold, z, observed_rate, lab, complete):
    """Estimate how much onset innovation carries into the late-hold slope."""
    late = t > np.median(t)
    weights = np.zeros(2)
    if not late.any():
        return weights
    rng = np.random.default_rng(610)
    fold = np.empty(len(lab), dtype=int)
    for j in range(4):
        for ok in (False, True):
            ids = rng.permutation(np.flatnonzero((lab == j) & (complete == ok)))
            fold[ids] = np.arange(len(ids)) % 4
    slope = np.full(len(lab), np.nan)
    innovation = slope.copy()
    for k in range(4):
        fit = complete & (fold != k)
        val = complete & (fold == k) & np.isfinite(observed_rate)
        if fit.sum() < 9 or not val.any():
            continue
        tau, theta = _fit(x[fit], h[fit], p[fit], dt, t, threshold, z[fit], observed_rate[fit])
        curves, rates = _design(tau, x[val], h[val], p[val], dt, t, threshold)
        residual = (z[val] - curves @ theta)[:, late] / t[late]
        rows = np.flatnonzero(val)
        usable = np.isfinite(residual).any(axis=1)
        slope[rows[usable]] = np.nanmedian(residual[usable], axis=1)
        innovation[val] = observed_rate[val] - rates @ theta
    for wing in (0, 1):
        valid = (lab // 2 == wing) & np.isfinite(slope) & np.isfinite(innovation)
        if valid.sum() >= 6:
            u = innovation[valid]
            weights[wing] = np.clip(u @ slope[valid] / max(u @ u, 1e-12 * len(u)), 0.0, 1.0)
    return weights
